verdict.rationale: Weave exposes a Service API with REST endpoints for programmatic access, plus SDK-level ops for tracing, evaluations, and cost tracking, and an OpenAPI spec is served, indicating broad API coverage. However, some UI-centric features (Playground model comparison/testing, leaderboards, Slack alert configuration) are documented mainly as UI workflows without explicit evidence that every one of these is fully API-exposed. missing for 10: explicit documentation confirming Playground, leaderboards, and alerting/webhook configuration are all fully controllable via the API/SDK rather than just the UI.
